tacticalIdentity: Temperature spectrum master. Applies OVERHEATED (+35 temp) and OVERCOOLED (-35 temp) in the same kit. Triggers THERMAL SHOCK (bonus damage + STUN) when a unit transitions between extremes in one turn. Amplifies Pyromancer and Cryomancer output simultaneously. The only Mancer that can invert an enemy's temperature state in a single spell.
designNotes: THERMAL SHOCK triggers when OVERCOOLED unit receives OVERHEATED (or vice versa) in the same activation. Bonus damage = |ΔTemp| / 2. STUN for 1 turn. Thermomancer immune to temperature DoT from its own Thermal Gradient Zone.

baseSpells.description: A focused heat projectile dealing 14 damage. Applies OVERHEATED (+35 temperature, 4 HP/turn fire DoT, fire damage received +50%, 3-turn duration). On a SUPERCOOLED target: THERMAL SHOCK triggers. Melts ICE_TILE to WET terrain.
baseSpells.designNotes: Primary OVERHEAT applicator. +35 temp reaches HOT from neutral in one hit. THERMAL SHOCK setup half when followed by Cold Lance.

baseSpells.description: A mirror of Heat Lance dealing 14 cold damage. Applies OVERCOOLED (-35 temperature, 3 HP/turn cold DoT, cold damage received +50%, movement -2, 3-turn duration). On an OVERHEATED target: THERMAL SHOCK triggers. Flash-freezes WET units to FROZEN.
baseSpells.designNotes: Mirror of Heat Lance. Cold Lance + Heat Lance in same activation = THERMAL SHOCK (35 bonus damage + STUN, 4 AP total).

baseSpells.description: Deals 10 Thermal damage and flips the target's current temperature to its opposite extreme (multiplies temperature by -1.5, clamped to ±100). OVERHEATED becomes OVERCOOLED; OVERCOOLED becomes OVERHEATED. This transition always triggers THERMAL SHOCK on pre-conditioned targets. Highest single-cast temperature swing in the roster.
baseSpells.designNotes: Highest-skill-expression spell. Two-turn setup (Heat Lance + Thermal Inversion) is the most AP-efficient THERMAL SHOCK path.

baseSpells.description: Creates a persistent 6-tile zone (3-tile hot half + 3-tile cold half) with a midline. Hot half: BURNING terrain (+5 HP/turn fire DoT, OVERHEATED on entry, +15 temp/turn). Cold half: PERMAFROST terrain (+3 HP/turn cold DoT, OVERCOOLED on entry, -15 temp/turn). Units crossing the midline in a single movement trigger THERMAL SHOCK. Duration: 4 turns.
baseSpells.designNotes: Most complex placement. Neither option (stay on side / cross midline) is safe. Forces 3-way decision: stay hot, stay cold, or cross and THERMAL SHOCK.

baseSpells.description: Opens a thermal conduit between the Thermomancer and an allied unit. The ally's temperature is set to the Thermomancer's current temperature level, then locked for 2 turns (temperature-altering effects cannot move it). Max heat bonus: +2 fire damage on attacks. Max cold bonus: +2 defense, apply SLOWED to attackers. Thermomancer may redirect incoming BURNING or FROZEN effects to the ally during the conduit.
baseSpells.designNotes: Augmentation spell. Temperature-state sharing and active redirect. Pyromancer pre-heats Thermomancer, then shares max HEAT to a melee unit for +2 fire damage.
